title: Reconstruction of a Boolean list from indexed values
statement: Let $a\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $l$ be a Boolean list of length $a$. The list whose $j$th entry, for $j\in\{0,\ldots,a-1\}$, is the $j$th entry of $l$ when present and false otherwise is exactly $l$.
